request.prompt:
Goods: Analogue quartz wristwatch, stainless steel case
Country of origin: CH

Chosen so far: 91 Clocks and watches and parts thereof > 9102 Wrist-watches, pocket-watches, stop-watches and other watches, other than those of heading no. 9101

Choose the subheading that covers these goods. Options:
- 910229: Wrist-watches; whether or not incorporating a stop-watch facility, with other than automatic winding
- 910221: Wrist-watches; whether or not incorporating a stop-watch facility, with automatic winding

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: The subheadings in 9102.2 cover mechanical-display watches with battery or other non-electric power; the goods are an analogue quartz watch, which is not automatic winding, so it falls under 'other than automatic winding'. 9102.1 (electrically operated) is not offered, so 910229 is the best available match.}
